# freshdesk_skill (Resource)

A routing skill that matches tickets to the agents who hold it.

~> Freshdesk serves two different shapes here depending on whether the account is on omniroute. Classic accounts take `match_type`, `agent_ids` and a flat `conditions` array. Omniroute accounts reject all three and take channel-scoped conditions instead:

```hcl
conditions = jsonencode([{
  channel = "ticket"
  channel_conditions = [{
    name       = "condition_set_1"
    match_type = "all"
    properties = [{
      resource_type = "ticket"
      field_name    = "priority"
      operator      = "in"
      value         = [4]
    }]
  }]
}])
```

Set only the attributes your account accepts; the provider omits the rest.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the skill.

### Optional

- `agent_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the agents who hold the skill. Classic accounts only; omniroute accounts reject this field and assign skills to agents through `freshdesk_agent.skill_ids` instead.
- `conditions` (String) Matching rules as a JSON array. On a classic account each element takes `resource_type`, `field_name`, `operator` and `value`, plus an optional `nested_fields` object for dependent fields. On an omniroute account each element is channel-scoped; see the example above.
- `match_type` (String) Whether `all` or `any` of the conditions must match. Classic accounts only; omniroute accounts reject this field and carry the match type inside each condition set.
- `rank` (Number) Evaluation order of the skill. Lower ranks match first.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the skill was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the skill.
- `updated_at` (String) When the skill was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_skill.example 42
```
